headline: Xiaomi surges to #2; Qwen and Poolside make debuts
summary: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 jumped two spots to claim the runner-up position with 9.8% token share, gaining 1.7 percentage points in a single day. Meanwhile, Qwen entered the rankings at positions 37 and 45, and Poolside's laguna-xs made its first appearance at rank 48. DeepSeek remains firmly in control at 25.7% provider share despite a small daily dip.
highlights: Xiaomi mimo-v2.5 vaults to rank 2 with 9.8% share (+1.7% in 1d)
Qwen debuts with two models: qwen3.8-max at rank 37 (0.4% share) and qwen3.7-flash at rank 45 (0.3% share)
Poolside laguna-xs enters at rank 48 (0.2% share)
OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini debuts at rank 51 (0.2% share)
Four models dropped out: Google gemini-3.1-pro-preview, Anthropic claude-4.6-opus, OpenAI gpt-5.4-nano, and Moonshot AI kimi-k2.5
